evidence: Tao Sach Pagoda, also known as Chùa Tảo Sách, is a serene Buddhist sanctuary nestled peacefully by the vast, wavy waters of Tây Hồ, a tranquil haven that has been a source of spiritual solace for centuries. This ancient pagoda, built on the former residence of the revered Prince Linh Lang during the Mạc Dynasty in the 16th century, exudes an air of profound tranquility and absolute peace.
